Python Developer (Backend) - FinStack Technologies, Pune (Hybrid)
Full-time

About the role
FinStack builds payment reconciliation software for banks and fintech companies. We are looking
for a Python Developer to design, build and scale the backend services behind our platform.

What you will do
- Design, build and maintain REST APIs and microservices in Python (Django / FastAPI)
- Write efficient SQL and optimise PostgreSQL queries for high-volume transaction data
- Improve performance with caching (Redis) and asynchronous task queues (Celery)
- Containerise services with Docker and deploy them to AWS
- Write unit and integration tests and take part in code reviews
- Work with product managers and frontend engineers to ship features end to end

Requirements
- 2-4 years of professional experience in backend development
- Strong Python, Django or FastAPI, REST APIs, SQL and PostgreSQL
- Experience with Git and Docker
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field

Nice to have
- Kubernetes, Celery, CI/CD pipelines, GraphQL
- Experience in fintech or payments
- AWS certification

Soft skills: clear communication, ownership, teamwork.
